samples.summary: New shared read walk recurses into nested tables; the write path (`Doc.applyInlineStyle`) does not — reintroducing the read/write divergence this module exists to remove
samples.evidence: `visitStyledRunsInRange`'s `visitTable` recurses when a cell block is itself a table (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:75-79). The write it claims to mirror does not: `Doc.applyInlineStyle`'s table branch loops rows/cells and calls `store.applyStyle(cellBlock.id, 0, len, ...)` with `len = getBlockTextLength(cellBlock)`, which is 0 for a nested table block, so nested-table content is never styled (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:415-429). Nested tables are a supported docs feature (packages/docs/src/view/table-layout.ts:475, packages/docs/src/view/selection.ts:136). Consequence for a cross-block selection containing a table that contains a nested table: the read sees the nested runs (unstyled) so `isStyleOnInSelection` / the summary answer "not all on" forever, the write styles only the outer runs, and Cmd+B / the toolbar button can never remove bold again — the exact #715 shape.

samples.summary: `stepSelectionFontSize` still carries the old duplicated walk, breaking the documented invariant that it uses the same traversal as `getRangeStyleSummary`
samples.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl` keeps the pre-change dispatch, including the body-only `layout.blockParentMap` lookup the diff's own comment calls unable to resolve header/footer cells (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1163-1164) and no cell→table normalization for cross-block ranges. Its doc comment asserts "the same block/offset dispatch `getRangeStyleSummary` uses" (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1080-1082), and docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:213 repeats it — both are now false because the summary moved to `visitStyledRunsInRange` (doc.blockParentMap, table normalization, table recursion). Observable: for a multi-block selection inside a header/footer table cell the size picker now reads a real value/'mixed' while the ± stepper collects zero runs and silently does nothing; for a selection spanning a body table the summary reports the table's sizes as 'mixed' but the stepper never touches them.

samples.summary: Text-box editors (docs text boxes, slides shape/text-box text) now have a keyboard-vs-toolbar disagreement: the shared keyboard walk layers named-style defaults, their own `getRangeStyleSummary` does not
samples.evidence: `TextEditor` is also instantiated by the docs text-box editor (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:666), which slides wraps (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:109, 601-602). The new `isStyleOnInSelection` reads effective styles including `resolveStyleInline` defaults (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:52), but the text-box summary the toolbars read walks raw `inline.style` only, with no defaults layered (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1067-1088). Heading 6's built-in style sets `italic: true` (packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:91), so on a heading-6 block in a text box Cmd+I now writes `italic:false` while `TextFormatGroup`/mobile-toolbar show the button unpressed and apply `italic:true` — the same class of read disagreement the change set out to remove. The task note claims both editors resolve defaults identically (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:31-34), which is not true of the text-box implementation.

samples.summary: Existing summary consumers (font size/family pickers, hunt oracle) now see table-cell runs in cross-block selections and will read 'mixed' where they previously read the paragraph value
samples.evidence: The old body walk computed `blockLen` from `block.inlines` for a table block (0), so table content in a cross-block selection was never sampled; the new walk visits every cell (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:164-166). Unchanged consumers of the same summary: packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/use-resolved-font-size.ts:31, use-resolved-font-family.ts:31, packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:318 (sizeValue/familyValue), and the hunt oracle packages/frontend/src/app/harness/hunt/bridge.ts:176. A selection dragged across a table now renders those pickers empty/'mixed' — arguably more correct, but it is an unflagged behaviour change for consumers outside the diff (and, per finding 2, the ± stepper cannot act on the 'mixed' it now reports).

samples.summary: Toggle decisions became O(selected runs) on paths that were previously O(1), including every toolbar render
samples.evidence: `TextFormatGroup` now calls `editor.getRangeStyleSummary()` on each render (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:96) plus once per key inside each handler (lines 100-121), and the keyboard path walks the range once per boolean key (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2895, 3013). Previously both read the single-position `getSelectionStyle()`/`getStyleAtCursor()`. With select-all on a large document — and with the new table recursion pulling in every cell of every selected table — this is a full-range walk on every cursor-move-driven toolbar re-render and on every Cmd+B/I/U/Shift+X press.

finding.summary: New shared read walk recurses into nested tables; the write path (`Doc.applyInlineStyle`) does not — reintroducing the read/write divergence this module exists to remove
finding.evidence: `visitStyledRunsInRange`'s `visitTable` recurses when a cell block is itself a table (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:75-79). The write it claims to mirror does not: `Doc.applyInlineStyle`'s table branch loops rows/cells and calls `store.applyStyle(cellBlock.id, 0, len, ...)` with `len = getBlockTextLength(cellBlock)`, which is 0 for a nested table block, so nested-table content is never styled (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:415-429). Nested tables are a supported docs feature (packages/docs/src/view/table-layout.ts:475, packages/docs/src/view/selection.ts:136). Consequence for a cross-block selection containing a table that contains a nested table: the read sees the nested runs (unstyled) so `isStyleOnInSelection` / the summary answer "not all on" forever, the write styles only the outer runs, and Cmd+B / the toolbar button can never remove bold again — the exact #715 shape.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. The shared read walk recurses into nested tables (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:74-79, reached from the cross-block table branch at :164-166), while the write it claims to mirror does not: Doc.applyInlineStyle's table branch (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:415-429) iterates cell.blocks and only calls store.applyStyle when getBlockTextLength(cellBlock) > 0, with no recursion into cellBlock.tableData. getBlockTextLength sums block.inlines (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:326-328) and table blocks are created with inlines: [] (types.ts:530-533, import/docx-importer.ts:492-496), so nested-table content is never styled. Nested tables are a real, supported feature (view/table-layout.ts:79 and :474-493, view/table-renderer.ts:209-214, view/selection.ts:136-149, tests at packages/docs/test/view/nested-table-layout.test.ts:52-57 and packages/docs/test/import/docx-importer.test.ts:1348-1352). Consequence: isStyleOnInSelection (view/text-editor.ts:3007-3018) sees the unstyled nested runs and returns false forever, so toggleStyle (:2895-2898) always re-applies rather than removes — the #715 divergence this module exists to eliminate; the toolbar summary shares the same walk (view/editor.ts:2849). No guard elsewhere excludes nested tables from the read walk. In-lane for blast radius: a contract/invariant mismatch with an unchanged counterpart outside the diff; major impact.

finding.summary: `stepSelectionFontSize` still carries the old duplicated walk, breaking the documented invariant that it uses the same traversal as `getRangeStyleSummary`
finding.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl` keeps the pre-change dispatch, including the body-only `layout.blockParentMap` lookup the diff's own comment calls unable to resolve header/footer cells (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1163-1164) and no cell→table normalization for cross-block ranges. Its doc comment asserts "the same block/offset dispatch `getRangeStyleSummary` uses" (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1080-1082), and docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:213 repeats it — both are now false because the summary moved to `visitStyledRunsInRange` (doc.blockParentMap, table normalization, table recursion). Observable: for a multi-block selection inside a header/footer table cell the size picker now reads a real value/'mixed' while the ± stepper collects zero runs and silently does nothing; for a selection spanning a body table the summary reports the table's sizes as 'mixed' but the stepper never touches them.

verdict.reason: Every element of the finding is present as described. stepSelectionFontSizeImpl (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1089-1228) retains a private duplicated walk with the body-only layout.blockParentMap lookups at editor.ts:1163-1164, while getRangeStyleSummary now delegates to visitStyledRunsInRange at editor.ts:2849. The shared walk (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:112-115, 146-147, 164-167) uses the merged doc.blockParentMap (populated with header/footer parentage at editor.ts:1406-1413), normalizes cell endpoints to their parent table block, and recurses into tables inside cross-block selections — none of which the stepper does (its cross-block loop at editor.ts:1155-1161 calls collectRunsInBlock on a table block whose own inlines are empty, and it never normalizes cell endpoints before doc.getBlockIndex at 1148-1149). Consequently a multi-block selection inside a header/footer cell falls through 1163-1191 collecting zero runs and returns silently at 1198 even though the picker reports a concrete value or 'mixed', and a body selection spanning a table reads as 'mixed' while the stepper leaves the table untouched. The invariant is asserted in the stepper's own doc comment (editor.ts:1079-1082) and repeated in docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:211-214; both are now false. Reachable from the toolbar via packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:368. This is a changed shared read-walk contract with an unupdated sibling consumer — in lane for blast-radius, and major by impact. No refutation ground applies.

finding.evidence: `TextEditor` is also instantiated by the docs text-box editor (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:666), which slides wraps (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:109, 601-602). The new `isStyleOnInSelection` reads effective styles including `resolveStyleInline` defaults (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:52), but the text-box summary the toolbars read walks raw `inline.style` only, with no defaults layered (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1067-1088). Heading 6's built-in style sets `italic: true` (packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:91), so on a heading-6 block in a text box Cmd+I now writes `italic:false` while `TextFormatGroup`/mobile-toolbar show the button unpressed and apply `italic:true` — the same class of read disagreement the change set out to remove. The task note claims both editors resolve defaults identically (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:31-34), which is not true of the text-box implementation.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. The shared TextEditor is instantiated by the docs text-box editor (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:666) and wrapped by slides (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:601-602), so the new range-aware keyboard read applies there. isStyleOnInSelection (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3007-3019) uses visitStyledRunsInRange, which layers named-style defaults via resolveStyleInline (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:52,58). The text-box getRangeStyleSummary the toolbars read walks raw inline.style with no defaults (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1067-1088); resolveStyleInline appears nowhere in that file, unlike the full docs summary (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2849). heading-6's built-in style sets italic:true (packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:91) and heading blocks are reachable inside a text box via the shared TextEditor's markdown auto-convert (text-editor.ts:2309-2313) and Cmd+Alt+6 (text-editor.ts:1027-1037), plus TextBoxEditorAPI.setBlockType (text-box-editor.ts:1172-1178); text-box layout resolves those defaults (text-box-editor.ts:461-468 -> layout.ts:149-157), so the block really renders italic. Consumers then disagree: text-format-group.tsx:106,181 and slides mobile-toolbar.tsx:237,260 show italic unpressed and apply italic:true, while Cmd+I (text-editor.ts:876-880 -> toggleStyle 2895-2898) computes "on" and writes italic:false. No guard elsewhere reconciles them; the task note's claim of identical default resolution (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:31-34) is not true for the text-box implementation. This is a changed-contract-with-unupdated-consumer issue outside the diff, i.e. squarely in the blast-radius lane, and major.

finding.summary: Keyboard toggle reads RAW run styles while the toolbar's getRangeStyleSummary() layers named-style inline defaults — the two still disagree (e.g. built-in Heading 6 is italic)
finding.evidence: New `isStyleOnInSelection` reads `(inline.style as Record<string, unknown>)[key]` with no named-style layer (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3021), and its docstring claims it "Mirrors the toolbar's `getRangeStyleSummary()` decision so keyboard and toolbar agree". But the out-of-diff toolbar source layers style defaults: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2847 `const defaults = styleDefaultsForBlock(block);` then `{ ...defaults, ...inline.style }` (editor.ts:2855). `BUILTIN_STYLES['heading-6'].inline` contains `italic: true` (packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:91), and any user-redefined style can add bold/italic/underline (see packages/docs/test/model/named-styles.test.ts:97 producing `{fontSize:28, bold:true}`). Result: with a selection inside a Heading 6, the toolbar Italic button reads pressed and one click removes italic, while Cmd+I computes inRange=false and writes `italic:true` — a visually no-op first press, i.e. the same class of bug #715 the change claims to close. Fix belongs on the new `visit()` in text-editor.ts (layer `resolveStyleInline(blockStyleId(block), this.doc.document.styles)` under the run style), or the docstring's parity claim must be dropped.

verdict.reason: The claimed code does not exist. `isStyleOnInSelection` (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3007-3019) does not read `(inline.style as Record<string, unknown>)[key]`; it calls the shared `visitStyledRunsInRange(this.doc, range, (style) => …)` (text-editor.ts:3013, imported at :21), and that walk already layers named-style defaults under each run: `const defaults = resolveStyleInline(blockStyleId(block), doc.document.styles)` then `visit({ ...defaults, ...inline.style }, …)` (packages/docs/src/view/range-runs.ts:52,58) — precisely the fix the finding prescribes. The toolbar's `getRangeStyleSummary()` range path uses the same shared walk and the same effective style (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2849-2851), not the claimed `styleDefaultsForBlock` + `{ ...defaults, ...inline.style }` (that appears only at editor.ts:2792 in the separate collapsed-caret `styleAtCaret()` helper). So the two paths do agree; for a Heading 6 selection `isStyleOnInSelection('italic')` sees `italic: true` from the layered defaults and returns true, so the described no-op-first-press divergence cannot occur. The cited line text-editor.ts:3021 is `// --- Cell helpers ---`, and the only occurrence of the quoted raw-style read in packages/ is text-box-editor.ts:1077, a different symbol in the slides text-box editor. The docstring's parity claim (text-editor.ts:2998-3002) is therefore accurate as written.
